The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

I checked both pages of the category (32 books). Five books are rated five stars:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

The browser tab is still open on page 2 of the category, where the winning book is listed.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval 'document.querySelector(".form-horizontal").innerText'

cd /tmp; S=task-cd12b5749260; F='JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod")].map(a=>[a.querySelector(".star-rating").className.split(" ")[1],a.querySelector("h3 a").title,a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText]).filter(x=>x[0]=="Five"))'; agent-browser --session $S eval "$F"; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/page-2.html >/dev/null; agent-browser --session $S eval "$F"
